Lead-only work 2026-10-17T23:07:08Z to 23:22:51Z (no sub-agent running) moved five_hour 0.02 -> 0.12, about 0.40 per hour of active lead work, so lead-reserve is five_hour 0.25 (about 40 minutes of it) and seven_day 0.10. rate could not learn this: the run was not dispatched through the adapter, so every pair of readings during it had no recorded outcome tokens (README Usage windows, friction item 17))
